title: Collection and the family tree in Hebrew
changes: The Collection step reads in Hebrew: the file counts, the people strip, the material cards and their type badges, adding files and folders, what was removed from the story and how to put it back.

The family tree reads in Hebrew too — the chart, the right-click menu, a person's full details, connecting two people already in the tree, choosing portraits from tagged faces, and the GEDCOM explainer for anyone who has never met the format.

How people are related is now written in Hebrew rather than assembled from English words: "אח/ות של", "הורה של", and the reasons a link cannot be made. The word joining two parents is translated with its spacing, because Hebrew's ו attaches to the next word instead of standing alone.
The translator now keeps one identity per language, so screens that depend on it no longer re-run their work on every render.
